chapters.title: Breakfast
chapters.text: You sat at a wooden table with a plate of scrambled eggs, tomatoes, and toast, alongside a ceramic mug.

chapters.title: Preparing vegetables
chapters.text: You and the caregiver prepared vegetables together. You cut carrots on a wooden board while a younger woman tore kale into a bowl.
caregiver_facts: The caregiver and the older woman prepared vegetables together.

chapters.title: Reading
chapters.text: You sat in an armchair and read an open book. A mug rested on a small wooden table next to a window with potted plants.

chapters.title: Looking at photos
chapters.text: Your daughter Anna visited you. You and Anna looked through a photo album together on the sofa.
caregiver_facts: The visitor was her daughter Anna.
Anna and the older woman looked through a photo album together.

chapters.title: Dinner
chapters.text: You sat at a wooden table with a plate of food including salmon, broccoli, carrots, and rice, along with a mug.
